title: Sanderson Has an Offer

nodes.speaker: Sanderson
nodes.text: Boss. Good to see ya.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Boss. Good to see ya.

nodes.speaker: Sanderson
nodes.text: You.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You.

nodes.speaker: Sanderson
nodes.text: Just because we're the same model doesn't mean we're identical. He doesn't even have a subdermal knuckle spike enhancement.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just because we're the same model doesn't mean we're identical. He doesn't even have a subdermal knuckle spike enhancement.

nodes.speaker: Sanderson
nodes.text: Well... yeah but that's not the point.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well... yeah but that's not the point.

nodes.speaker: Sanderson
nodes.text: Best way to be, boss. But say you wanted a little MFN...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Best way to be, boss. But say you wanted a little MFN...

nodes.speaker: Sanderson
nodes.text: Money for Nothing. Well, almost nothing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Money for Nothing. Well, almost nothing.

nodes.speaker: Sanderson
nodes.text: Boss was impressed with the last job you did. So impressed he wants you to do it for REAL this time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Boss was impressed with the last job you did. So impressed he wants you to do it for REAL this time.

nodes.speaker: Sanderson
nodes.text: Yeah. Bought his husband an apartment as a birthday gift and wants it furnished. No expense spared. Fill it with... I dunno, lamps, rich people shit.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah. Bought his husband an apartment as a birthday gift and wants it furnished. No expense spared. Fill it with... I dunno, lamps, rich people shit.

nodes.speaker: Sanderson
nodes.text: Boss won't be happy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Boss won't be happy.

nodes.speaker: Sanderson
nodes.text: Yeah... only thing is, the current owner wasn't exactly happy about selling.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah... only thing is, the current owner wasn't exactly happy about selling.

nodes.speaker: Sanderson
nodes.text: You're a real pro.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're a real pro.

nodes.speaker: Sanderson
nodes.text: Not stolen. Repossessed. Happens all the time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not stolen. Repossessed. Happens all the time.

nodes.speaker: Sanderson
nodes.text: How you feel about earning a little MFN?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How you feel about earning a little MFN?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: "Me." Do you want me to help you like I helped Rollo?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: "Me." Do you want me to help you like I helped Rollo?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: "Me." Do you want me to help you like I helped Rollo?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: "Me." Do you want me to help you like I helped Rollo?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What it is, Sandertron?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What it is, Sandertron?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sorry... I've been busy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry... I've been busy.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: DO you want the same thing, though? To redecorate an apartment?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: DO you want the same thing, though? To redecorate an apartment?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: DO you want the same thing, though? To redecorate an apartment?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: DO you want the same thing, though? To redecorate an apartment?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: MFN?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: MFN?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Lemme guess: you need another apartment "redecorated".

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Lemme guess: you need another apartment "redecorated".
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Lemme guess: you need another apartment "redecorated".
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Lemme guess: you need another apartment "redecorated".

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Spit it out, then.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Spit it out, then.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: For real?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: For real?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't want to be involved with your dodgy boss. No more schemes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't want to be involved with your dodgy boss. No more schemes.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't want to be involved with your dodgy boss. No more schemes.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't want to be involved with your dodgy boss. No more schemes.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sucks to be him, then, doesn't it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sucks to be him, then, doesn't it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sucks to be him, then, doesn't it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sucks to be him, then, doesn't it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds easy enough.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds easy enough.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Nothing I haven't dealt with before.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nothing I haven't dealt with before.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Nothing I haven't dealt with before.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Nothing I haven't dealt with before.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So I'll be decorating a stolen apartment?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So I'll be decorating a stolen apartment?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So I'll be decorating a stolen apartment?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So I'll be decorating a stolen apartment?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ugh, no way.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ugh, no way.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No problemo.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No problemo.
